android.desc:
🌟 Simple, Pure, and Powerful Full-Featured Offline RSS Reader

FeedMe is a full-featured offline RSS reader designed for power readers. Whether you use mainstream RSS cloud services, self-hosted servers, or local RSS, FeedMe delivers a seamless, distraction-free reading experience.

Why FeedMe?

🚫 100% Ad-Free: No interruptions, no noise. Just you and your content.

🤖 AI-Powered: Smart AI summaries and translation to help you digest global information faster.

💾 Ultimate Offline Reading: Automatically syncs full text and images—read anytime, anywhere, even without internet (on planes or subways).

🎙️ More Than Text: Full support for Podcast RSS and TTS (Text-to-Speech). Turn your articles into audiobooks.

✨ Key Features

【🤖 Smart & Efficient Reading】

AI Summary & Translation: Get the core ideas instantly and break language barriers.

Effortless Gestures: Swipe left/right in the article list and auto-mark as read while scrolling.

5 Layout Views: Choose from Minimal, Summary, List, Card, or Vision view to fit your style.

【🔄 Seamless Sync & Integration】

One-Click Save: Instantly send articles to Instapaper, Karakeep and Evernote.

Wide Compatibility:

Services: Bazqux, Feedbin, Feedly, Folo, Inoreader, The Old Reader.

Self-Hosted / APIs: Tiny Tiny RSS, Fever API, FreshRSS and other Google Reader APIs.

Instant State Sync: Custom sync preferences to keep your reading progress aligned across devices.

【🎨 Deep Personalization】

Tailored Themes: Light, Paper, Dark, Night, and a dedicated E-ink theme for eye comfort.

Read-Friendly UI: Uniform fonts and formatting. Includes a built-in picture viewer (GIF supported) and browser.

Power-User Tools: Volume buttons navigation, unread count widgets, and easy sharing via Email, SMS, or social apps.

🛡️ Community
Report issues or suggestion to the project:
🔗 Documentation: https://github.com/seazon/FeedMe

Download FeedMe today and take back control of your reading feed!

quotes.text:
To save others trouble: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.seazon.feedme

There's a fair amount of apps in the Play Store named "FeedMe".

I like FeedMe -- clean and functional interface, supports offline caching, works with common RSS providers too (e.g. I use it with Feedbin) https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.seazon.feedme
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: How do you RSS?

quotes.text:
NewsBlur is ugly. I mean it just looks oily.

The Old Reader doesn't provide an API yet it seems. (I had mailed awesome Android app FeedMe's[1] dev and that's what he said)

FeedHQ started taking payments(actually became paid only) without any features or implementation which is worthwhile.

Feedly is plague. Ask them why they need a Firefox extension to read their website.

FeedBin is one that sounds sane and I am going to stick to them till others improve.

We don't have an option, yet!

Besides, in most of the blog posts and comments people were worried about a reading client than a service which(latter) IMHO was the real loss.

[1]https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.seazon.feedme
